name: multistorey-cost-coverage-f13
description: v0.31.5.378 visual verification: on the two-storey Open Loft plan, the design report's finishes + per-room tables must include the UPPER storey's rooms (they were ground-only), and the toolbar room switcher must list them. Pro mode.

steps.name: load-loft-plan
steps.eval: (function(){ window.__loadErr=null; import('/src/floorplan/templates.ts').then(m => { const plan = m.PLAN_TEMPLATES.find(p => p.id === 'tpl-loft'); if (!plan) throw new Error('tpl-loft not in PLAN_TEMPLATES'); window.__store.getState().replaceFloorPlan(plan, { furniture: 'rehome' }); }).catch(e => { window.__loadErr = String(e); }); })()

steps.name: assert-upper-rooms-in-switcher-source
steps.eval: (function(){ window.__switcherIds=null; window.__switcherErr=null; import('/src/state/rooms.ts').then(({ editableRooms }) => { const ids = editableRooms(window.__store.getState().floorPlan).map(r=>r.id); for (const need of ['lfu-sleep','lfu-landing','lfu-ward']) { if (!ids.includes(need)) throw new Error('room switcher omits upper room '+need+' — got '+ids.join(',')); } window.__switcherIds = ids.join(','); }).catch(e => { window.__switcherErr = String(e); }); })()

steps.name: put-furniture-on-the-loft
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); const its=s.items; if(!its.length) throw new Error('no items to move'); const picks=its.slice(0,4).map(i=>i.id); const set=new Set(picks); s.setItems(its.map(it => set.has(it.id) ? { ...it, levelId:'lf-up', position:[1.0+picks.indexOf(it.id)*0.6, 4.2] } : it)); window.__loftItemIds=picks.join(','); })()

steps.name: patch-window-open
steps.eval: window.__capturedHtml=null; window.open=function(){ return { document:{ write:function(html){ window.__capturedHtml=html }, close:function(){} }, close:function(){}, focus:function(){}, print:function(){} }; };

steps.name: wait-report-html

waitFor.store: window.__reportErr ? (() => { throw new Error(window.__reportErr) })() : (typeof window.__capturedHtml === 'string' && window.__capturedHtml.length > 0)

steps.failMessage: openDesignReport() never wrote HTML via the intercepted window.open

steps.name: assert-upper-rooms-in-report
steps.eval: (function(){ const h=window.__capturedHtml; for (const need of ['Sleeping Loft','Dressing']) { if(!h.includes(need)) throw new Error('report HTML omits upper room: '+need); } if(!/Sleeping Loft<\/?[a-z]*>? · 4 items/.test(h) && !/Sleeping Loft · 4 items/.test(h)) throw new Error('the per-room FURNITURE breakdown does not credit the loft with its 4 items — an upstairs piece was filed Unassigned. (The lighting/electrical room tables were already level-aware, so a bare name match passes for the wrong reason.)'); })()

steps.name: scroll-to-upper-room
steps.eval: (function(){ const el=[...document.querySelectorAll('td')].find(e=>/Sleeping Loft · 4 items/.test(e.textContent||'')); if(!el) throw new Error('per-room furniture row for the loft not rendered'); el.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); })()
